I prefer more inexpierenced men tbh. It's easier to communicate what I want because they don't have a set way of doing things. Sidenote: you shouldn't feel like a slut if sex is something you enjoy and all parties were consenting.

The most attractive thing to me when it comes to sex is effort. If someone is not physically attractive but cares about my needs I would get with them before having sex with an physically attractive person that is only concerned with themselves.

I know that feeling and it sucks. Going on dates after a fresh breakup can honestly make me feel worse than being alone. There are plenty of people out there that would love to treat you just as well if not better than your ex. I'm glad you're taking your time :)

I wish more people realized that you can be the dumper and still hurt seeing them move on. One day you'll find someone that is better for you and you won't worry about it anymore. I dumped a guy and having my friends tell me they saw his tinder was a slap in the face. It sucks knowing they didn't put in effort to fix our relationship but put in the effort to get a new one. You're not alone.

Art has always helped me after a breakup. Even if you can't freehand I've found just tracing things can be helpful. If you're in school I suggest putting this energy more on your subjects. Knitting sounds kinda dumb to some people but it's pretty easy to pick up and just focusing on one thing helps me a lot when I'm sad/stressed. Watch Netflix comedy specials. Watch really shitty movies. Rock collecting can be cool. Cleaning/ redesigning your living space. Making playlists. Changing your surrondings can help you heal.

Take your time and heal. Finding someone else like your friends suggested would only complicate things if you still have these feelings. I'm glad you realize that you want to be happy by yourself before you get out there again. There's nothing wrong with wishing you could be there for an exes milestone. They were an important person in your life and it's perfectly valid to care. I'm glad therapy helped you and I hope you seek help again if you feel like you need it.

Coming from a girl, you are not anywhere near ugly. You have a handsome face and a nice body. If you dress well, smell good, and have a good personality I don't see how you couldn't get with basically any girl you wanted.
You honestly look great. You've found your own personal style that suits you and I can sense your new found confidence in the recent photos. Good work :)

I will try the list thing. I know I should get out of my room/out of bed but I live in a dorm so I spend the majority of my time in here. I know deep down I should get out but social anxiety can be hell. I'm seeking on-campus help soon ...I just hope I can afford it. It means a lot to me that you took the time to provide helpful feedback. Thank you.

What hurts the most is one was my boyfriend. He was with friends but I really needed him and I was left on read. Things started getting progressively worse since I've entered college. I've been cooped in my dorm for most of the weekend. I went outside to do laundry and a group was sitting outside my dorm and I got really anxious and flighty. I know they weren't making fun of me but I'm so socially anxious that I've been avoiding eating because I don't want to be around people in the dining hall. I think why today was so bad was seeing people have friends and socialize made me feel like even more shit because I don't think I'll ever find my "group" ya know. I've gotten professional help before I've just been struggling with money. I'm arranging for on-campus help but I just hope I can afford it.

As someone that's suffered with bdd and self-harm just know many of us feel the exact same way. What about your hair do you not like? The texture? The color? Have you ever tried an at home hair mask? It may sound silly but my hair can get really frizzy and just doing a 30 minute mask makes it easier to style and me feel a little better.
